definitions.gloss: developed country; advanced nation; industrialized country
definitions.explanation: A country with a highly developed economy, advanced technology, and high standard of living. Commonly used in news, politics, and economics.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{先進国|せんしんこく}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Japan is one of the developed countries.

examples.japanese: {先進国|せんしんこく}でも{貧困|ひんこん}{問題|もんだい}は{存在|そんざい}する。
examples.english: Poverty issues exist even in developed countries.

examples.japanese: G7は{主要|しゅよう}{先進国|せんしんこく}の{首脳|しゅのう}が{集|あつ}まる{会議|かいぎ}だ。
examples.english: The G7 is a summit where the leaders of the major developed nations gather.

notes:
The opposite term is {途上国|とじょうこく} (developing country) or {発展途上国|はってんとじょうこく} (developing nation). {先進国|せんしんこく} is the standard neutral term in Japanese media and official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{主要|しゅよう}{先進国|せんしんこく} — major developed nations
・{先進国|せんしんこく}{首脳|しゅのう}{会議|かいぎ} — summit of advanced nations
・{先進国|せんしんこく}と{途上国|とじょうこく} — developed and developing countries
・{先進国|せんしんこく}の{中|なか}で — among developed nations
